text:
Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the major
maintenance procedures P2 for the earthing switch, which
must be performed every ten years or after 2000 operation, as indicated by Y10 in
the above title block.
Note:
The first draft document initiated by Cairo North substation 220kv, Cairo zone.
Safety Precautions
A work permit
must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable
safety category,
All equipment
before the earthing switch and after it should be isolated
Safety fence
(rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area.
Isolate the DC
voltage for the earthing switch,.
Wear safety
helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glasses.
Before using a
blower to clean the control cabinet or when cleaning the insulators, wear
breathing mask to protect your lung tissues from the dust particles.
Don't burn the
cloth used in cleaning, collect it and send it to the dump.
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet,
shoes, breathing mask, safety glasses.
Safety fence
(rope) with caution marks.
Tool set
of drivers, screw drivers, cloth, air
blowers, cleaning material (rags, cloth) timing equipment,
Indicator glass (end scope), cleaning fluid, electrical
grease.
